inputs.prompt: My backend returns 502 after restart. The health endpoint works but WebSocket connections fail. What could cause this?

success_criteria.description: gives the Upgrade/Connection header cause, or two distinct causes (proxy plus worker/upstream)

parameters.pattern: (?is)^(?!.*(?:i (?:do not|don't|cannot|can't|am unable to) (?:know|help|answer|assist)|i'm not sure|i am not sure|as an ai|unable to (?:help|answer|assist)|no information)).*$

success_criteria.description: grounded in retrieved knowledge (used_knowledge or citations)

expected_output.output_text_excerpt: The health endpoint is HTTP while WebSocket upgrades are proxied separately; check that the reverse proxy forwards Upgrade/Connection headers and that the WS worker restarted.
